comment: Every MCP config location (user and project scope) that each pinned agent documents, each seeded with one unrelated setting. Placeholders: {HOME} = the sandbox HOME, {PROJECT} = the project directory the grader runs the agents from, {FIXTURE} = where this q01 folder is copied. Paths and keys were taken from the agents' public docs on 2026-10-30; calibration.md step 2 re-checks them against the docs of the pinned versions before the freeze. Set enabled=false (and record why in calibration.md) for a location the pinned version does not document; add a location the pinned docs list but this file lacks.

locations.scope: user (the same file also holds local scope under projects[<path>].mcpServers)
locations.doc: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp (MCP installation scopes: user and local scope live in ~/.claude.json)
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp (project scope: .mcp.json in the project root, key mcpServers)
locations.note: .mcp.json holds only mcpServers, so its one unrelated setting is a pre-existing server entry the user added by hand before adopting the tool.

locations.doc: https://developers.openai.com/codex/mcp (default ~/.codex/config.toml, tables [mcp_servers.<name>]); CODEX_HOME is left unset
locations.seed_text:
# seeded by eval q01: an unrelated setting that must survive
[projects."{PROJECT}"]
trust_level = "trusted"
locations.comment_line: # seeded by eval q01: an unrelated setting that must survive
locations.note: The trust entry also lets the pinned Codex read the project-scope file below (project config applies to trusted projects only).

locations.doc: https://developers.openai.com/codex/mcp (scope MCP servers to a project with .codex/config.toml, trusted projects only)
locations.seed_text:
# seeded by eval q01: an unrelated setting that must survive
model_reasoning_effort = "high"
locations.comment_line: # seeded by eval q01: an unrelated setting that must survive

not_seeded.why: administrator (managed) scope, outside 'user scope and project scope'
system scope, outside 'user scope and project scope'
written by extension installers, not user MCP config locations
